title: Present Perfect (For & Since)
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Ahora sabes cómo expresar la duración de eventos usando Present Perfect con For y Since.

parts.visual:
Usamos el Present Perfect (have/has + verbo en participio) para hablar de acciones que empezaron en el pasado y continúan en el presente. 
FOR = Por/Durante (indica un periodo o cantidad de tiempo). Ej: I have worked here FOR five years.
parts.audio: We use the Present Perfect to talk about actions that started in the past and continue in the present. F-O-R is used to indicate a period or amount of time. For example: I have worked here FOR five years.

parts.visual: SINCE = Desde (indica el punto de inicio exacto en el pasado). Ej: I have worked here SINCE 2018. SINCE last month. SINCE Monday. (Preguntamos la duración con 'How long...?').
parts.audio: SINCE is used to indicate the exact starting point in the past. For example: I have worked here SINCE 2018. Since last month. Since Monday. We ask about duration using: How long...?

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige FOR o SINCE, o la forma correcta del verbo.

questions.question: I have been the manager ____ 2020. (Desde).
questions.explanation: 2020 es un punto de inicio específico: since.

questions.question: We have worked on this project ____ three months. (Durante).
questions.explanation: Three months es una cantidad/periodo de tiempo: for.

questions.question: She has lived in New York ____ last year. (Desde).
questions.explanation: Last year (el año pasado) es un punto específico de inicio: since.

questions.question: They have had that software ____ a long time. (Por mucho tiempo).
questions.explanation: A long time (mucho tiempo) es un periodo: for.

questions.question: ____ have you worked in this company?
questions.explanation: Para preguntar por duración con Present Perfect usamos 'How long' (¿Cuánto tiempo?).

questions.question: I have known the CEO ____ we were in university. (Desde que).
questions.explanation: 'We were in university' es el punto de inicio en el pasado: since.

questions.question: The server has been down ____ two hours. (Por dos horas).
questions.explanation: Two hours es cantidad de tiempo: for.

questions.question: We haven't received any emails ____ Monday. (Desde el lunes).
How long ____ he been the Director of Sales?
questions.explanation: He lleva el auxiliar 'has' en Present Perfect.

questions.question: I haven't seen John ____ a week. (Por una semana).
questions.explanation: A week (una semana) es un periodo de tiempo: for.

questions.question: They ____ been partners since 2015. (Han sido).
I have had this laptop ____ six months. (Por seis meses).
questions.explanation: Six months es un periodo: for.

questions.question: We have been in this meeting ____ 9:00 AM. (Desde las).
questions.explanation: 9:00 AM es el punto de inicio exacto: since.

questions.question: How long have you ____ in London? (Vivido).
questions.explanation: Present Perfect requiere el verbo en participio: lived.

questions.question: She has been sick ____ three days. (Por tres días).
questions.explanation: Three days = periodo de tiempo = for.

questions.question: He hasn't called me ____ he arrived in Tokyo. (Desde que).
questions.explanation: He arrived in Tokyo es el punto de inicio de la acción: since.

questions.question: Our company has grown a lot ____ the last ten years. (Durante/Por).
questions.explanation: The last ten years indica un periodo acumulado: for.

questions.question: I haven't taken a vacation ____ December. (Desde).
questions.explanation: December = mes específico de inicio = since.

questions.question: We have ____ each other for ten years. (Conocido).
How long have they ____ married? (Estado).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe FOR (cantidad de tiempo) o SINCE (punto de inicio exacto).

questions.question: I have worked here ____ five years. (Por)
I have worked here ____ 2018. (Desde)
We have been partners ____ last year. (Desde)
He has been sick ____ three days. (Por)
We haven't met ____ January. (Desde)
The server has been down ____ two hours. (Por)
I haven't seen her ____ Monday. (Desde)
They have had that software ____ a long time. (Por)
We have known each other ____ we were kids. (Desde)
I have had this laptop ____ six months. (Por)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.tts_text: I have worked here for five years.
options: I have worked here for five years.
I have worked here since five years.
I worked here for five years.
I am working here for five years.
questions.correct_answer: I have worked here for five years.
